name: Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce
author: Nilesh Kanzariya

sections.description:
Are you tired of clicking “Complete Order” hundreds of times?
Let’s fix that in 1 minute.

👉 Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce is the easiest way to automatically mark WooCommerce orders as Completed — with smart rules for product type, payment method, and user roles.

No coding. No headaches. Just set it and forget it.

Why Store Owners Love This Plugin ❤️

  • ⚡ Save Hours Every Week – Never waste time completing orders again
  • 🎯 Smart Rules – Auto-complete based on products, payment gateways, and customer roles
  • 💸 Boost Customer Experience – Deliver products instantly after payment
  • 🔒 Safe & Secure – Cash on Delivery & unpaid gateways excluded
  • 🌍 Works Everywhere – Compatible with PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Venmo & more

Perfect for:
✅ Digital stores (courses, software, eBooks, music, videos)
✅ Subscription & membership sites
✅ Busy shop owners who value their time

💡 Imagine this: You’re asleep. A customer buys your product. It’s delivered instantly. No manual clicks. That’s freedom.

Documentation & Demo

📖 Documentation: https://nilsatwara.github.io/autocomplete-woocommerce-orders/
🖥️ Live Demo: Coming soon 🚀

Notes

Supported Gateways

✅ PayPal
✅ Stripe
✅ Square
✅ Apple Pay
✅ Google Pay
✅ Amazon Pay
✅ Klarna
✅ Afterpay
✅ Venmo
✅ All other gateways that confirm successful payment

Not Supported

❌ Cash on Delivery
❌ Check Payment
❌ Bank Transfer

(Excluded for security reasons — unpaid orders should not be auto-completed.)

Helpful Tips

  • Lightweight: won’t slow down your site
  • Works with all WooCommerce themes
  • Ideal for digital goods, courses, or memberships
  • Combine rules, e.g. auto-complete digital products via Stripe for logged-in users

Summary

Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce gives you full control over how and when WooCommerce orders are completed — saving you time and reducing errors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/autocomplete-for-woo-orders/
  2. Activate under Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Smart Autocomplete
  4. Turn on rules (products, roles, gateways)
  5. Done ✅ Orders will auto-complete without you lifting a finger
sections.faq:
Does it complete ALL orders?

Only if you want! You control which product types, roles, and payment gateways get auto-completed.

Is it safe for COD (Cash on Delivery)?

No 🚫 – COD, Check & Bank Transfer are blocked for security.

Which gateways are supported?

All major ones: PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Square, Venmo, and more.
